name: ai.dropslop/dropslop
title: DropSlop
description: See which phrases read as AI-written, rewrite what reads machine-made, and audit whole sites.

tools.name: dropslop_detect
tools.description: Score one or more texts with DropSlop's calibrated Dual-Head AI Detector (two trained heads: ModernBERT and Qwen-0.5B token surprisal, plus de-biased stylometrics). Returns p_ai (0.0-1.0), band (CLEAN, WARM, HOT), and per-head scores.

text.description: Single text or markdown document to score.

texts.description: Optional batch of texts to score in parallel.

tools.name: dropslop_xray
tools.description: Run a full paragraph-by-paragraph and sentence-by-sentence Slop X-Ray on a document. Identifies exact AI tell spans (throat-clearing openers, contrastive pivots, lexical cliches, em-dash overuse), sentence cadence flatness (CV), and bounded surgical edit suggestions.

text.description: Document markdown or prose to X-Ray.

heat_threshold.description: AI probability threshold (0.0-1.0) above which a paragraph is flagged.

tools.name: dropslop_surgical_humanize
tools.description: Rewrite only the paragraphs of a document that read machine-made, leaving CLEAN paragraphs and Markdown structure as they are, and run Fact-Guard, which checks that no names, numbers, dates or quotations were added or changed. Read the rewrite before you use it.

text.description: Input markdown or text to surgically humanize.

heat_threshold.description: Only rewrite paragraphs scoring above this AI threshold.

pinned_terms.description: Exact proper nouns, product names, or metrics that must never be modified.

style_rules.description: Optional explicit style constraints (e.g. 'no first person, no questions, no em dashes').

rewrite_mode.description: How far the rewrite may go: 'strict' (or 'auto') keeps sentence structure close and holds names, numbers and quotations fixed; 'stealth' allows bigger structural changes under the same Fact-Guard checks; 'dual' returns both drafts plus a sentence-aligned stealth_diff.

tools.name: dropslop_humanize
tools.description: Rewrite a document or long article so it reads less machine-made, using DropSlop's multi-paragraph cadence planner ('strict', 'stealth', or 'dual' mode returning both drafts and stealth_diff). Read the rewrite before you use it.

text.description: Input markdown or text to humanize.

rewrite_mode.description: Draft mode: 'strict' (default via 'auto') keeps structure close and names, numbers and quotations fixed; 'stealth' allows bigger structural changes; 'dual' returns strict_draft and stealth_draft plus stealth_diff.

heat_threshold.description: Only rewrite paragraphs scoring above this AI threshold.

pinned_terms.description: Exact proper nouns, product names, or metrics that must never be modified.

style_rules.description: Optional explicit style constraints (e.g. 'no first person, no questions, no em dashes').

tools.name: dropslop_reroll_paragraph
tools.description: Priority-0 single-paragraph surgical rewrite with surrounding sentence context, All-4-Gates ranking, and Fact-Guard.

tools.name: dropslop_site_audit
tools.description:
Crawl and audit a domain, sitemap, or URL list using DropSlop's high-speed Go crawler (fastcrawl) with automatic straggler cutoff, clean HTML

extraction, and batched AI detection.

wait_for_completion.description: If true, waits for initial crawl + straggler cutoff and returns the full report.

tools.name: dropslop_certify
tools.description: Issue a tamper-evident certificate (/v/{cert_id}): a signed record of this exact text (SHA-256 hash), the scores it got from DropSlop's checker and, for a verified certificate, from two outside detectors, and a Fact-Guard receipt. A certificate is a record of a check, not proof of who wrote the text. Uses one certificate per started 1,000 words (2,400 words = 3); text both outside detectors scored in the last 7 days uses none. Needs your own API key.

basic.description: A basic certificate: DropSlop's own check only, no outside detector. Free and unlimited, up to 5,000 words.

tools.name: dropslop_critique_for_agent
tools.description: Fast CPU Agent Self-Heal Critique (~2s, 0 GPU wait). Runs Detector v4, Slop X-Ray, Fact-Guard entity locking, Sentence-Claim coverage, Abstract Boilerplate detection, and 4-Dimension Brand Voice scoring. Returns `passes_all_gates`, `locked_entities_must_keep`, `hot_paragraphs_to_edit`, and a coordinate-indexed `agent_instruction_sheet` so the calling agent can surgically edit its own draft in 1-2 turns.

text.description: Current draft text to critique and verify.

original_text.description: Optional original source draft; Fact-Guard checks which of its names, numbers and claims the text keeps.

voice_profile_id.description: Optional voice_id from `dropslop_voice_profile` (defaults to the caller's latest Brand Voice or Editorial Human Baseline).

pinned_terms.description: Optional additional terms, metrics, or quotes that must remain verbatim.

tools.name: dropslop_voice_profile
tools.description: Build and save a statistical Brand or Author Voice Fingerprint from a domain/blog crawl (`crawl_target`), URL list (`urls`), existing Site Audit (`audit_job_id`), connected CMS/Workspace (`connector_provider`: 'gdocs', 'notion', 'wordpress', 'ghost', 'hubspot', 'webflow', 'shopify'), or raw sample texts (`texts`). Automatically filters out AI-contaminated articles so old AI slop never pollutes the human voice baseline.

name.description: Label for this Brand/Author Voice profile.

crawl_target.description: Optional domain, blog path, or sitemap URL to crawl for human writing samples (e.g. 'https://company.com/blog/').

urls.description: Optional list of specific article URLs to extract human writing samples from.

audit_job_id.description: Optional completed `dropslop_site_audit` job_id to extract clean human pages from.

connector_provider.description: Optional connected CMS/Workspace integration to pull writing samples from.

connector_item_ids.description: Optional specific document/post IDs or URLs to import from the connector.

connector_query.description: Optional search query when listing documents from the connected account.

texts.description: Optional direct writing sample texts (>= 40 words each).

banned_terms.description: Optional brand-specific banned words or phrases.

tools.name: dropslop_voice_diff
tools.description: Score any draft 0-100% against a saved Brand/Author Voice profile (`voice_profile_id`) across 4 dimensions (cadence & burstiness, register & contractions, concreteness vs. jargon, lexical brand hygiene) and return actionable voice-drift rewrite instructions.

text.description: Draft text to score for Brand/Author Voice alignment.

voice_profile_id.description: Saved `voice_id` from `dropslop_voice_profile` (or omit to use latest/default Brand Voice).

tools.name: dropslop_verify_live_citations
tools.description: Deterministic live web citation, verbatim quote, and attributed stat forensics (0 GPU). Extracts inline Markdown links, bare URLs, direct quotes (>= 5 words), and quantitative claims (%, $, multipliers like 3.4x, N=... sample sizes, years) with exact character offsets, fetches cited pages via an SSRF-safe reader, and classifies each item as VERIFIED_EXACT, PARAPHRASED_IN_QUOTES (catches LLMs rewriting words inside quotation marks), STAT_MISMATCH, UNSUPPORTED_BY_SOURCE, DEAD_LINK, or UNATTRIBUTED_NO_URL.

text.description: Draft markdown or prose containing citations, quotes, or quantitative claims.

urls_override.description: Optional explicit public http(s) source URLs to verify claims against.

source_texts.description: Optional map of {url: html_or_prose_text} for pre-fetched source pages.

timeout_s.description: Per-URL HTTP fetch timeout in seconds.

tools.name: dropslop_corpus_monoculture_check
tools.description: Cross-article sameness check (0 GPU): finds articles that share one template, the pattern search engines treat as scaled, low-value content. Compares a draft against corpus_texts, a completed site audit (audit_job_id), an SSRF-safe sitemap crawl (crawl_target), and/or the caller's saved library documents across 4 sensors: opening-hook skeleton collisions, H2 section-arc cloning, 64-bit SimHash + 5-word shingle & stock-metaphor reuse, and TF-IDF + entity/stat topic cannibalization.

text.description: New draft markdown or prose to test for corpus monoculture.

audit_job_id.description: Optional completed dropslop_site_audit job_id owned by the caller.

crawl_target.description: Optional public domain or sitemap URL to sample up to max_corpus_docs pages from.

corpus_texts.description: Optional comparison articles (strings or {doc_id, title, url, text} objects).

include_saved_documents.description: Include the signed-in caller's saved documents in DropSlop Library.

tools.name: dropslop_information_gain_delta
tools.description: SERP Competitor Consensus Graph & Paragraph-Level Information Gain scorer (0 GPU). Ingests up to 10 competing reference_urls (SSRF-safe) and/or reference_texts, extracts net_new_entities and net_new_metrics absent from competitors, calculates fact_to_filler_per_100w, and classifies every prose paragraph as HIGH_GAIN, MODERATE_GAIN, CONSENSUS_REPEAT, or GENERIC_FILLER.

text.description: Draft markdown or prose to score for Information Gain.

reference_urls.description: Optional competing SERP article URLs (max 10, http/https public only).

reference_texts.description: Optional pre-fetched competing articles (strings or {title, url, text} objects).

tools.name: dropslop_edit_lineage_attest
tools.description: Issue a tamper-evident Cryptographic Edit-Lineage & Process Provenance Certificate (`lin_...`) with a SHA-256 hash chain, binary Merkle root, and HMAC-SHA256 signature from either a caller-owned `doc_id` or explicit `revisions` (minimum 2). Supports `privacy_mode=True` (zero intermediate draft text stored) and computes edit kinematics (`ORGANIC_ITERATIVE_DRAFTING` vs `SINGLE_PASTE_BULK_INSERT` vs `SURGICAL_POLISH_PASS`).

doc_id.description: Caller-owned DropSlop `doc_id` whose `document_versions` should be attested.

revisions.description: Ordered revision snapshots (minimum 2) when attesting outside DropSlop Library.

privacy_mode.description: When true (default), intermediate draft texts are never stored in the public receipt.

pinned_terms.description: Optional entities/metrics to track across outline-to-final continuity.

tools.name: dropslop_stylometric_authorship_verify
tools.description: Quantitative Forensic Stylometry & Spliced-Author Radar using Burrows' Classic Delta and Cosine Delta over 100 function words, punctuation-pair transitions, clause-initial lexical distribution, Yule's K, and word-length Shannon entropy. Supports single-author verification, multi-author attribution ranking, and intra-document spliced-paragraph voice fracture detection (`>= 1.8` SD).

text.description: Target document or article text to examine.

author_samples.description: Known human writing samples from the claimed author.

candidate_authors.description: Optional map of author name -> list of writing samples for multi-author attribution ranking.

voice_profile_id.description: Optional saved `voice_id` fallback when `author_samples` is omitted.

fracture_sd_threshold.description: Standard-deviation threshold for flagging spliced-author paragraphs (>= 25 words).

tools.name: dropslop_skim_and_dropoff_forensics
tools.description: Psycholinguistic Reader Skim & Drop-Off Heatmap calibrated across 5 reader personas (`journalist_pitch`, `exec_memo`, `technical_rfc`, `blog_reader`, `academic_reviewer`). Computes `words_to_first_concrete_anchor`, left-branching syntactic delay, subordinate-clause depth, nominalization sludge, monotony runs, `predicted_completion_pct`, `first_dropoff_sentence_idx`, and plain-English `skim_fixes`.

text.description: Draft prose or markdown to analyze for reader drop-off.

tools.name: dropslop_diff_gate
tools.description: CI/CD & CMS Pre-Publish Diff Gate (`PASS` | `WARN` | `BLOCK`). Accepts a unified `git diff` (`diff_text`) or `before_text` + `after_text`, extracts only added/modified prose blocks (>= 18 words, skipping fenced code, YAML frontmatter, and raw tables), batch-scores AI probability + Brand Voice + banned terms + AI tells + broken markdown links `[text]()`, and returns file/line-anchored annotations.

before_text.description: Optional baseline text when not passing `diff_text`.

after_text.description: Optional updated text when not passing `diff_text`.
